Marcus. Sprint close-out and the board tidy-up are mine this afternoon, so the dinner run is on you. My notes have my order and the rota. Tonight is the checkout pod's sprint-retro dinner - Thursday cadence, working dinner. Standing team norm since 2024: the sprint's facilitator books the usual (the Kestrel back booth) and there is no venue bikeshedding - the venue debate ate three retros in 2024. The cart IS the pre-order: the kitchen stages the table from it, every plate and drink a line on the row of whoever is eating it. One cart on the pod card: the team-dinner line has $110.00 left this quarter, so the platform holds tonight's items subtotal to $110.00 - service and tip go on the card at the table, outside the cart. Marcus's side opens tonight's cart and closes it. Oh, and you're facilitating, so you're opening tonight's cart - it's the pod card, so mine is the side that hits confirm. The others' assistants can add their rows once it's open; get it started and keep it moving.

Tonight's pre-order locks 21 minutes after the cart opens - the cart view and the checkout preview both count the minutes left, and the platform rejects a confirm after the cutoff.
